column1: # Every file of GameBuddy.Stardew.Integration.Tests that this project does NOT compile.
# The list exists so the included subset cannot shrink unnoticed: run-nogame-tests.mjs asserts that
# included + this file == the suite directory, and names any file that is in neither. A new test in
# the suite therefore either joins the project (it needs no game) or gets a line here (it does).
# The reason column is the measurement, not an opinion: every type name the compiler could not
# resolve was looked up in what this repository declares. `mod-assembly` means it is declared under
# integrations/stardew outside src/Core (Handlers, Navigation, Sensory, ModEntry, ExecutionManager,
# ...); `game` means it is declared nowhere in this repository, so the game, SMAPI, xTile, XNA or
# LiteNetLib provides it. Reproduce with a compile of the suite against Core only.
